Scalar triple-product identity for physical cut-boundary orientation. Strict linear height-bound reduction over ordered fields. Vieta sum/product identities for two distinct roots of a quadratic over fields. Cylinder radial contraction identity supporting exact strict interior witnesses. Positive homogeneous blending supports the denominator argument for rational NURBS evaluation.
